import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

TARGETS = [
    'OFICIAL | Entrada superior | cobertura',
    'OFICIAL | Entrada superior | fachada direita',
    'OFICIAL | Entrada superior | fachada esquerda',
    'OFICIAL | Entrada superior | lintel',
    'OFICIAL | Entrada superior | parede lateral A',
    'OFICIAL | Entrada superior | parede lateral B',
    'OFICIAL | Terminal alto | piso de entrada',
    'OFICIAL | Terminal alto | galeria piso',
    'OFICIAL | Terminal alto | galeria cobertura',
    'OFICIAL | Terminal alto | apoio junto encosta'
]

def bounds_world(o):
    pts=[o.matrix_world @ Vector(c) for c in o.bound_box]
    mins=tuple(round(min(p[i] for p in pts),4) for i in range(3))
    maxs=tuple(round(max(p[i] for p in pts),4) for i in range(3))
    return mins,maxs

print('FILE='+bpy.data.filepath)
print('SCENE='+bpy.context.scene.name)
for name in TARGETS:
    o=bpy.data.objects.get(name)
    if not o:
        print('MISSING='+name)
        continue
    loc=tuple(round(v,4) for v in o.location)
    rot=tuple(round(v,6) for v in o.rotation_euler)
    dim=tuple(round(v,4) for v in o.dimensions)
    mins,maxs=bounds_world(o)
    cols=[c.name for c in o.users_collection]
    print(f'OBJ={name}|LOC={loc}|ROT={rot}|DIM={dim}|MIN={mins}|MAX={maxs}|COLL={cols}')
